The law was adopted in November 2014 and the Commission reports work permits issued under the foreigners legislation in 2023 and 2024, so the general permit regime is in use. This does not cover the free-access clause for EU citizens, which by Serbia's account takes effect only on accession, and whether that clause survives is unknown.
